name: quiz-question
title: Quiz Question
description: A multiple-choice question with the energy of a live quiz and the manners of a form: big answer tiles you can tap, click or pick with a number key, an optional clock that rewards speed, and a reveal that marks the right answer, says in words how you did…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/quiz-question

Installed to `components/ui/games/quiz-question.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/quiz-question';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/quiz-question

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
